'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Uttarakhand tunnel rescue]]
**Rescuers in [[Uttarakhand]], [[India]], successfully drill through to 41 men trapped for over two weeks following a tunnel collapse. [https://www.cnn.com/2023/11/28/india/india-tunnel-rescue-vertical-drilling-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)]
*A [[rock burst]] at a coal mine in [[Shuangyashan]], [[Heilongjiang]], [[China]], kills eleven miners. [https://abcnews.go.com/amp/Business/wireStory/11-die-coal-mine-accident-chinas-heilongjiang-province-105204860 (AP via ABC News)]
*Four [[miner]]s are killed and another is injured after a [[water transportation|water pipeline]] ruptured inside a [[coal mining|coal mine]] in [[Jaworzno]], [[Poland]]. [https://apnews.com/article/poland-coal-miners-killed-61d92987371864b6695a6b3222230b74 (AP)]
*Three people are killed in an explosion at a business in [[Hillsboro, Ohio|Hillsboro]], [[Ohio]], [[United States]]. [https://www.whio.com/news/local/firefighters-searching-victims-after-explosion-ohio-business/G5H4ZPIXXFBEVOJPX6QIDB7CZI/?outputType=amp (WHIO)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Expo 2030]]
**[[Saudi Arabia]]’s capital [[Riyadh]] is chosen to host the 2030 World Expo, over [[South Korea]]n port city [[Busan]] and [[Rome]] for the event expected to draw millions of visitors. [https://www.gdnonline.com/Details/1297040/Riyadh-chosen-to-host-2030-World-Expo (GDN Online)]
*[[Finland–Russia relations]]
**[[Finland]] closes the entire [[Finland–Russia border|border with]] [[Russia]] after accusing the [[Government of Russia|Russian government]] of facilitating the entry of [[asylum seeker]]s into the country. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/nov/28/finland-closes-entire-border-with-russia-after-tensions-over-asylum-seekers (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Russia–United States relations]]
**A [[District courts of Russia|Russian district court]] extends American journalist [[Evan Gershkovich]]'s detention on [[espionage]] charges until January 30, 2024. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20231128-russian-court-extends-detention-of-us-journalist-gershkovich (AFP via France 24)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Hijab and burka controversies in Europe]]
**The [[Court of Justice of the European Union]] rules that employees can be banned from wearing "signs of religious belief", such as [[Islam]]ic [[hijab]]s, in all [[European Union]] member states. [https://news.yahoo.com/employees-banned-wearing-headscarves-top-180114403.html (''The Independent'' via Yahoo! News)]
*[[Regulation of electronic cigarettes]]
**The [[Australian government]] announces a ban on the import of disposable [[electronic cigarettes]], effective January 1, 2024, in an effort to reduce [[Nicotine dependence|nicotine addiction]] in children and [[young adult]]s. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-australia-67550685 (BBC News)]
